requirements.title: Ordered path to done
requirements.statement: A task reaches Done only by being prepared, started, sent for review and approved, in that order.

requirements.title: Done is final
requirements.statement: A task in Done accepts no further lifecycle commands.

requirements.title: Commands use the current revision
requirements.statement: A command written against an older revision of the task is refused.

requirements.title: Work is defined before it is prepared
requirements.statement: Work is prepared only once a nonblank outcome and at least one acceptance criterion are recorded; it does not need an owner yet.

requirements.title: Starting names the worker without a takeover
requirements.statement: Starting work names who is doing it. It assigns that person only if the task has no owner and never takes over another owner's task.

requirements.title: The owner requests review
requirements.statement: Only the task's owner can send it for review.

requirements.title: Independent, explicit review decision
requirements.statement: A review decision comes from a named reviewer who is not the owner, is made by that reviewer, and states the decision explicitly.

requirements.title: A review applies to what was reviewed
requirements.statement: A review counts only for the task, revision, content and model version it was given for.

requirements.title: Rework needs a fresh review
requirements.statement: A reviewer can send work back for changes; the reworked task needs a fresh review before it can be approved.

requirements.title: Malformed input is rejected first
requirements.statement: Malformed task or command input is rejected before any lifecycle rule is applied.

requirements.title: Revision never wraps around
requirements.statement: A command that would push the revision past its maximum is refused instead of wrapping around.

requirements.title: Each accepted command advances the revision once
requirements.statement: Every accepted command advances the task revision by exactly one.
